'''Robert Goodell Brown''' (1923–2013) was renowned in field of [[forecasting]], specifically with major contributions of work regarding [[exponential smoothing]]. He was an [[International Institute of Forecasters]] member, and a past director. He contributed to the field of forecasting with practical books.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://forecasters.org/blog/2013/10/09/robert-g-brown-1923%E2%88%922013/ | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190921020359/https://forecasters.org/blog/2013/10/09/robert-g-brown-1923%E2%88%922013/ | archive-date=2019-09-21 | title=Robert G Brown (1923−2013) - International Institute of Forecasters }}</ref>
